Suddenly, a little star fell into the garden!

Every evening he hid behind a big rock.
One evening, a kind octopus came with a lantern.
Together they found shells that glow in the night.
The little fish was not afraid anymore. He fell asleep smiling. Good night!

But the wind blew it everywhere: here, there and even further!
So the moon said: come, I saved you a place next to me.
Lena and her friend gave the little cloud a kiss.
And the little cloud had lovely, soft dreams. Good night!
